system.description:
Cursed item (seems an Efreeti Bottle). Opened, it lays a curse on the opener: Disadvantage on one save of the GM's choice until Remove Curse.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
A brass bottle sealed with a stopper. Unstop it (an action) and roll d20: 1–2 a hostile efreeti attacks you; 3 it grants up to 3 wishes, each copying a spell of 8th level or lower; 4–20 it serves you for 1 hour. It can be released once.

Rarity: Very Rare
